svg.title: ChronoNote app icon — "dated page" (0.7 iconography pass)
svg.desc: The same dated-page-under-its-rule mark the in-app "Open date note" toolbar button uses (src/lib/icons/paths.ts, "date-note"), scaled up so the taskbar icon and the toolbar button read as one thing (docs/design/maturity-0.7-roadmap.md, "The app icon rejoins the family"). Replaces the §96 checkbox-clock mark. Shipped treatment is a white knockout on the accent-blue tile, same as before — only the mark itself changed. Regenerate with: npx tauri icon docs/design/icon-A-master.svg
